title: Two-tape code table type
statement: For each natural number $n$, a two-tape code table with $n+1$ states assigns to every state and every triple consisting of the possibly blank input symbol and the possibly blank symbols under the two work-tape heads an action of a two-work-tape machine over the Boolean alphabet, with state set of size $n+1$.
